events.title: Tupac Shakur's Passing
events.blurb: Commemorating the passing of Tupac Shakur in Las Vegas. He would have been 55.

angles.name: Tupac's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering Tupac Shakur, a voice that defined a generation. His impact on music and culture remains undeniable.

events.title: Jimi Hendrix Remembered
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of rock legend Jimi Hendrix's death. He would have been 84.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Jimi Hendrix: the man who redefined the electric guitar. His music still electrifies decades later.

events.title: Abbey Road Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' iconic 'Abbey Road' album was released on this day in 1969.

angles.name: Walk the Walk
angles.copy: That iconic zebra crossing, those unforgettable tracks. 'Abbey Road' changed music forever. What's your favourite from the album?

events.title: Chrissie Hynde turns 75
events.blurb: Celebrating the birthday of The Pretenders' frontwoman, Chrissie Hynde, who turns 75 today.

angles.name: Hynde's Enduring Voice
angles.copy: Happy 75th to the indomitable Chrissie Hynde! Still rocking, still inspiring.

events.title: Liam Gallagher turns 54
events.blurb: Happy birthday to Oasis frontman and rock icon, Liam Gallagher, who turns 54 today.

angles.name: Rock 'n' Roll Star
angles.copy: Our kid turns 54! Happy birthday to the one and only Liam Gallagher. What's your favourite Oasis or solo track?

events.title: 'Imagine' Release Anniversary
events.blurb: John Lennon's timeless anthem 'Imagine' was released on this day in 1971.

angles.name: A Song for Peace
angles.copy: Fifty-five years since John Lennon asked us to 'Imagine'. A message that resonates louder than ever.

events.title: The Original iPod Turns 25
events.blurb: On this day in 2001, Apple unveiled the revolutionary first-generation iPod, turning 25.

angles.name: Pocket Full of Tunes
angles.copy: Remember the click wheel? The original iPod arrived 25 years ago today, changing how we listen to music forever.

events.title: James Bond Day
events.blurb: Celebrating James Bond Day, marking the premiere of the first Bond film, 'Dr. No', in 1962.

angles.name: Shaken, Not Stirred
angles.copy: It's James Bond Day! Who's your favourite 007 and what's the ultimate Bond theme tune?

events.title: John Lennon would have been 86
events.blurb: Remembering the legendary John Lennon on what would have been his 86th birthday.

angles.name: Lennon's Enduring Spirit
angles.copy: On what would have been his 86th birthday, we celebrate the life and music of John Lennon. His message of peace lives on.

events.title: John Cleese turns 87
events.blurb: Happy birthday to the iconic comedian and actor, John Cleese, who turns 87 today.

angles.name: Comedy Legend
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 87th birthday to the brilliant John Cleese! From Python to Fawlty Towers, a true comedy icon.

events.title: The 'White Album' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' self-titled double album, known as the 'White Album', was released on this day in 1968.

angles.name: The Beatles' Eclectic Masterpiece
angles.copy: The 'White Album' dropped on this day in '68. Its diverse sound showed The Beatles at their most experimental. What's your standout track?

events.title: Remembering Freddie Mercury
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the passing of Queen's legendary frontman, Freddie Mercury. He would have been 80.

angles.name: The Show Must Go On
angles.copy: Remembering the incomparable Freddie Mercury, who left us on this day. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: 'Rubber Soul' Anniversary
events.blurb: The Beatles' groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul' was released on this day in 1965.

angles.name: A New Direction for The Beatles
angles.copy: On this day in '65, The Beatles released 'Rubber Soul', an album that saw them push new boundaries. Which track stands out for you?

events.title: Remembering John Lennon
events.blurb: Marking the anniversary of the tragic passing of music icon John Lennon. He would have been 86.

angles.name: Lennon's Lasting Impact
angles.copy: Forty-six years since we lost John Lennon. His music and message continue to inspire generations.
